Container.Name: roost
Container.Overview: A home for your remote coding agents, built for herdr. Claude Code, Codex, opencode and friends run in this container and you drive them over SSH with herdr (herdr.dev): close the laptop and they keep working; reattach from another machine or your phone. Pubkey-only SSH as user agent, no sudo, no Docker socket. Paste your public key(s) into Public keys (comma-separated), then connect: ssh -p 2222 agent@[unraid-ip]. First start installs the tools (a few minutes, see the log).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: claude codex opencode herdr ai agent coding ssh dev box
Container.Requires: An SSH key pair on the device you connect from. Internet access on first start (tools install into the home folder, a few minutes).

Config.Name: SSH port
Config.Description: Port your devices connect to (ssh -p 2222 agent@unraid). Keep it on LAN/VPN.

Config.Name: Public keys
Config.Description: SSH public keys allowed to log in as agent, comma-separated (laptop, phone, ...).

Config.Name: Heeler pairing
Config.Description: 1 = pair phones with Heeler by QR (run roost-pair in the box). Lets ~/.ssh/authorized_keys grant logins, which agents in the box can write.

Config.Name: Heeler addresses
Config.Description: Addresses the phone reaches Unraid on (LAN IP, Tailscale IP, DNS name), comma-separated. Go into the pairing QR.

Config.Name: Heeler port
Config.Description: Port for the pairing QR. Keep it equal to SSH port.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Logins, repos and tools. Survives updates.

Config.Name: SSH identity
Config.Description: Host key (generated on first start) and extra authorized_keys.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the home folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the home folder.

Config.Name: Git user.name
Config.Description: Git identity for commits made in the box.

Config.Name: Git user.email
Config.Description: Git identity for commits made in the box.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional. Logs gh in on start and lets git use it for HTTPS. Fine-grained, only the repos you need.

Config.Name: Harnesses
Config.Description: Coding agents to install (mise ids, space-separated).

Config.Name: Tools
Config.Default: herdr uv gh glab npm:ccusage npm:playwright npm:@playwright/mcp
Config.Description: Extra tools (mise specs). herdr is required.

Container.Config: herdr uv gh glab npm:ccusage npm:playwright npm:@playwright/mcp
